name: Blood Tainted
summary: After a Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit destroys an enemy unit near an objective it controls more strongly than the enemy, it keeps control of that objective until the opponent's Level of Control there is higher at a phase's end.

name: Murdercall
summary: In your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a Legiones Daemonica Khorne unit, that unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

name: Unholy Avalanche
summary: A friendly Legiones Daemonica Mounted unit that fell back this turn can still shoot and declare a charge as normal.

name: Unnatural Energies
summary: After Advancing or Falling Back, a Legiones Daemonica unit can perform a Tactical Manoeuvre: Secure Site, Set to Defend, or Set Overwatch.

name: Warp Rifts
summary: A Legiones Daemonica unit deep striking wholly within your Shadow of Chaos, or within 6" of a matching-god Greater Daemon, can set up more than 6" from enemies instead of 8".

name: Beguiling Aura
summary: Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh units can declare a charge in a turn they Fell Back.

name: Seductive Gambit
summary: After a Charge move, a Legiones Daemonica Slaanesh unit can trade Fights First for the rest of the turn to instead re-roll Hit rolls and Wound rolls of 1 when it fights.

name: Loci of Power
summary: Friendly Legiones Daemonica Character models (excluding Monsters) get +1 Leadership and +1 Objective Control.

name: Melancholic Miasma
summary: Enemy units within 9" of a Legiones Daemonica Nurgle unit count as in your Shadow of Chaos. Each player's Command phase, one enemy unit there must take a Battle-shock test.

name: Fates in Flux
summary: Start with 3 Flux tokens. Spend one to re-roll an Advance, Hit, Wound, Damage, save or Hazardous roll for a Tzeentch Legiones Daemonica unit, giving your opponent a token; they can do the same back to you.

name: First Prince of Chaos
summary: Grants a god-specific bonus to Shadow Legion units: shoot/charge after advancing, Stealth with -1 to be hit in melee, -1 to wound if hit by higher Strength, immunity to snap shots, or Dark Pacts and Deep Strike.

name: Thralls of the First Prince
summary: Bars Daemon Princes and Epic Heroes (except Be'lakor) from your army, but allows a points-capped list of Heretic Astartes units instead; those units gain the Shadow Legion keyword.

name: Shudderblink
summary: A friendly Legiones Daemonica Battleline unit that advances gains Assault on its ranged weapons for the turn and remains eligible to declare a charge.
